targetContract.rule: Reuse the existing three target runtimeBounds once; do not apply instance scale twice.

rootMapping.facing: Modern facing -1 selects source left/sign +1; modern +1 selects right/sign -1.
rootMapping.independence: Each projectile owns its root and follow history.
rootMapping.sourceCoordinate: Source root and target positions use existing twip conversion.

sampling.algorithm: Use per-frame native bounds intersection. Truncate dimensions. qx=trunc(round((source.x-intersection.x)*20)/5), qy likewise; field phase=((qy%4+4)%4)*4+(qx%4+4)%4; offset=origin-floor(q/4). Count source field bits inside intersection.
sampling.blank: Reject zero area before placing any field.
sampling.precision: No observed differences in frozen cases; universal AIR raster equivalence is not claimed.

lifecycle.attackId: Source attack-id snapshot plus projectile instance identity; target accepted-hit dedup.
